name: Dustwallow Bay
summary: Vessels thread the shallow waters of Dustwallow Bay on their way to Theramore Isle. The inlet lies between Dustwallow Marsh and the island, with coves and shoals far from eastern Kalimdor’s main sea routes.

sections.title: Waters of the Eastern Marsh
sections.body: At Dustwallow Marsh, murky wetlands meet the Great Sea. Theramore Isle lies to the east, and ships cross the bay to reach Lady Jaina Proudmoore’s island haven. Vessels come and go from its docks, though the coast remains wild and dangerous. Rocky outcrops, murloc encampments, and hidden inlets such as Tidefury Cove line the shore.

sections.title: A Fisherman's Haven
sections.body: Beyond the marsh’s crocolisks and hostile beasts, the islands and inlets offer quiet waters and rich catches. Small islets near Tidefury Cove draw anglers seeking solitude. Nat Pagle, the famed fisherman, often casts from the rocks, away from Theramore’s crowds.

faq.answer: Dustwallow Bay runs along the eastern coast of central Kalimdor, between the sodden eastern shores of Dustwallow Marsh and Theramore Isle.

faq.q: Who can be found in the bay?
faq.answer: Nat Pagle, the famed angler, can be found in the bay’s outer reaches. He camps on a small islet in nearby Tidefury Cove, southwest of Theramore Isle.

faq.q: Is Dustwallow Bay safe to swim across?
faq.answer: Swimming across the bay is dangerous. Murlocs, sharks, and other aggressive aquatic wildlife frequent its shallows and coasts.

angles.text: For Alliance sailors and travelers bound for Kalimdor, Dustwallow Bay is the last stretch of open sea before Theramore Isle’s fortified harbor.
